row.evidence: Reclaim's pricing page lists 'SSO & SCIM user provisioning' only under Enterprise ($22 per seat/month, unavailable on monthly plans), and the Okta SCIM guide requires a Reclaim.ai Enterprise Plan or a Business Trial.
row.notes: Status unchanged (gated). Prices changed since June: the pricing page now shows Starter $10, Business $15 and Enterprise $22 per seat/month on yearly billing (Starter $12 and Business $18 monthly; Enterprise unavailable monthly), replacing June's 'Starter $10 monthly / $8 annual, Enterprise $22 monthly / $18 annual'. Enterprise needs 100 seats. SSO is OIDC only (SAML not supported) and must be set up before SCIM. SCIM base https://api.app.reclaim.ai/scim/v2 with a Reclaim API key as bearer token. Okta uses the generic SCIM 2.0 Test App (the OIN app is OIDC only); Entra uses a non-gallery app; OneLogin has a 'Reclaim AI (SCIM provisioning only)' catalogue app. Deprovisioning deletes (no suspend). June note about Dropbox acquisition not re-verified on a first-party page and dropped.

endpoints.notes: Users endpoint implied by create/update/deactivate and Okta import; other endpoints not documented.

operations.notes: Okta: Create Users, Update User Attributes, Deactivate Users. OneLogin: deletion only, suspension not supported. Group assignment in Okta is supported for provisioning; Group Push is not documented.

deprovision.notes: OneLogin guide says Reclaim supports delete, not suspend. Removing a team member frees the paid seat (manual-removal article; not stated specifically for SCIM).

custom.how: Reclaim extension urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:reclaimai:2.0:User (location, hireDate, jobCategory, orgRole, team) plus arbitrary camelCase attributes under urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:reclaimai:attributes:2.0:User

attributes.notes: Default Okta mappings are not listed in text; Entra guide maps userName and externalId. Manager is sent via Okta's managerValue (manager email).

roles.how: orgRole is an informational org-chart attribute, not a Reclaim permission role; no role mapping documented

limitations.text: Okta's catalogue app is SSO (OIDC) only; SCIM uses the generic SCIM 2.0 Test App (Header Auth).
No suspend/deactivate support from OneLogin; delete only.
Requires Enterprise (minimum 100 seats, annual) or a Business Trial, plus SSO configured.

scim.notes: Prerequisites also include Auto Capture on the team, a Google service account or Microsoft service principal, and a Reclaim Team Admin. Entra uses https://api.app.reclaim.ai/scim/v2?aadOptscim062020.

user_api.notes: Reclaim issues API keys (used as SCIM bearer tokens) but no public user-management REST API reference was found; webhooks documented are for Scheduling Links only.

okta.notes: OIN page marks only OIDC. SCIM is set up through Okta's generic SCIM 2.0 Test App (Header Auth).

entra.notes: Non-gallery 'Create your own application' with Reclaim's SCIM tenant URL; Entra SSO via custom app guide.

google.notes: Google sign-in is OAuth (social); no Google Workspace provisioning documented.

onelogin.notes: From Reclaim's guide: 'Reclaim AI (SCIM provisioning only)' app in the OneLogin catalogue, separate from the OIDC SSO app. OneLogin page not loaded.

fallbacks.other_sync: Enterprise Domain Capture / Auto Capture adds users from your domains to the team; Google Workspace service account or Microsoft service principal rollout

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Up to 100 seats. Okta SCIM guide also allows a Business Trial.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Minimum 100 seats. SSO is OIDC only.

Whether SCIM deletion frees the seat is stated only for manual removal.

JumpCloud and Google Workspace provisioning not documented.
